title: Adolescent alcohol use (person-period data)
description: Alcohol use of 82 adolescents measured at ages 14, 15 and 16, in person-period (long) format.
source_citation: Singer, J. D., & Willett, J. B. (2003). Applied longitudinal data analysis: Modeling change and event occurrence. Oxford University Press.
source_route: Companion data of the book, distributed by UCLA OARC; reached the package through the UC Berkeley EDUC 275B course files.
redistribution_basis: Companion data of a published textbook, freely distributed for teaching by UCLA OARC.

title: Berkeley graduate admissions: two departments
description: Applicant-level records for two departments (B and E) of the 1973 UC Berkeley graduate admissions data, for studying Simpson's paradox.
source_citation: Bickel, P. J., Hammel, E. A., & O'Connell, J. W. (1975). Sex bias in graduate admissions: Data from Berkeley. Science, 187(4175), 398-404. https://doi.org/10.1126/science.187.4175.398
source_route: Subset of berkeley prepared for the UC Berkeley EDUC 275B course.
redistribution_basis: Published aggregate admissions table (also in base R as datasets::UCBAdmissions), expanded to one row per applicant.

title: Berkeley graduate admissions: five departments
description: Applicant-level records of the 1973 UC Berkeley graduate admissions data for departments B to F.
source_citation: Bickel, P. J., Hammel, E. A., & O'Connell, J. W. (1975). Sex bias in graduate admissions: Data from Berkeley. Science, 187(4175), 398-404. https://doi.org/10.1126/science.187.4175.398
source_route: Via Agresti and Finlay, Statistical Methods for the Social Sciences (exercise data), and the UC Berkeley EDUC 275B course files.
redistribution_basis: Published aggregate admissions table (also in base R as datasets::UCBAdmissions), expanded to one row per applicant.

title: Simulated class survey
description: Simulated look-alike of a 44-student class survey from 2007: study and work hours, height, weight, exercise, sleep and alcohol use.
source_citation: Simulated data (regdatasets 1.0.0), modeled on a 2007 class survey from the UC Berkeley Graduate School of Education.
source_route: Generated by a seeded simulation in data-raw/recipes/classdata_07.R; the original survey is not distributed.
redistribution_basis: Simulated data created for this package; no third-party data are included.
notes: Simulated: the original 2007 class survey has no consent or release record.

title: Florida county crime rates
description: Crime rate, median income, high-school graduation and urbanization for the 67 counties of Florida.
source_citation: Agresti, A., & Finlay, B. (2009). Statistical methods for the social sciences (4th ed.). Pearson Prentice Hall. Florida crime data, courtesy of L. Winner, University of Florida.
source_route: Textbook data file (Florida.dat), via the UC Berkeley EDUC 275B course files; also in the CRAN package smss as fl.crime.
redistribution_basis: Published textbook data of county aggregates, redistributed on CRAN (smss).

title: School discipline: NELS:88 original items
description: Whether 2,000 NELS:88 eighth graders were sent to the office for misbehavior, with background items in their original NELS coding.
source_citation: National Center for Education Statistics. (1988). National Education Longitudinal Study of 1988 (NELS:88), base-year student data [Public-use data file]. U.S. Department of Education.
source_route: Teaching extract of 2,000 NELS:88 students prepared for UC Berkeley GSE courses (EDUC 293A/275B).
redistribution_basis: NCES public-use data; every NELS variable is in the public-use files.
notes: Same 2,000 students, in the same order, as disc2.

title: School discipline: NELS:88 with SES and test scores
description: The same 2,000 NELS:88 students as disc, with socioeconomic status and reading and mathematics test scores.
source_citation: National Center for Education Statistics. (1988-1990). National Education Longitudinal Study of 1988 (NELS:88), base year and first follow-up [Public-use data files]. U.S. Department of Education.
source_route: Teaching extract of 2,000 NELS:88 students prepared for UC Berkeley GSE courses (EDUC 293A/275B).
redistribution_basis: NCES public-use data.
notes: Same 2,000 students, in the same order, as disc.

title: Faculty salaries
description: Academic-year salaries, rank and experience of 514 faculty members at Bowling Green State University, 1993-94.
source_citation: DeMaris, A. (2004). Regression with social data: Modeling continuous and limited response variables. Wiley. https://doi.org/10.1002/0471677566
source_route: 514-case file of Rabe-Hesketh and Skrondal, Multilevel and Longitudinal Modeling Using Stata (Stata Press companion data), via the UC Berkeley EDUC 275B course files.
redistribution_basis: Published textbook data, publicly redistributed by the publisher and Stata Press; contains no names.

title: GCSE and London Reading Test scores
description: Exam scores at age 16 and reading test scores at age 11 for 4,059 students in 65 inner-London schools.
source_citation: Goldstein, H., Rasbash, J., Yang, M., Woodhouse, G., Pan, H., Nuttall, D., & Thomas, S. (1993). A multilevel analysis of school examination results. Oxford Review of Education, 19(4), 425-433. https://doi.org/10.1080/0305498930190401
source_route: The Exam data of the Centre for Multilevel Modelling (Bristol), rescaled by 10, via the UC Berkeley EDUC 275B course files; also in the CRAN package mlmRev as Exam.
redistribution_basis: Freely downloadable teaching data, redistributed on CRAN (mlmRev) and by Stata Press.
notes: The model-output column pred was removed in 1.0.0.

title: Essay grades and text features
description: Grades (4 levels) and six text features of 198 student essays.
source_citation: Johnson, V. E., & Albert, J. H. (1999). Ordinal data modeling. Springer. https://doi.org/10.1007/b98832
source_route: Extract of essays.dta from Rabe-Hesketh and Skrondal, Multilevel and Longitudinal Modeling Using Stata (Stata Press), via the UC Berkeley EDUC 275B course files.
redistribution_basis: Published textbook data, publicly redistributed by Stata Press and on CRAN (mvord).

title: General Social Survey 1998
description: Attitudes, sexual partners, income, religion and background of 2,832 respondents to the 1998 General Social Survey.
source_citation: Davern, M., Bautista, R., Freese, J., Herd, P., & Morgan, S. L. (2026). General Social Survey 1972-2024 [Data file]. NORC at the University of Chicago.
source_route: Teaching extract of the 1998 GSS cross-section, of unknown authorship, via the UC Berkeley EDUC 275B course files.
redistribution_basis: GSS public-use data, distributed by NORC for research and teaching; cited as NORC requires.

title: High School and Beyond: five schools
description: Math achievement, SES and school characteristics of 188 students in five High School and Beyond schools.
source_citation: Raudenbush, S. W., & Bryk, A. S. (2002). Hierarchical linear models: Applications and data analysis methods (2nd ed.). Sage.
source_route: The five lowest-numbered schools of the HSB file, as defined in Rabe-Hesketh and Skrondal (Stata Press), via the UC Berkeley EDUC 275B course files; the full file is also on CRAN (nlme::MathAchieve).
redistribution_basis: NCES public-use survey data, widely redistributed (CRAN nlme, mlmRev; Stata Press).

title: High School and Beyond: 350 students
description: Test scores, locus of control, self-concept, motivation and background of 350 High School and Beyond students.
source_citation: Tatsuoka, M. M. (1988). Multivariate analysis: Techniques for educational and psychological research (2nd ed.). Macmillan.
source_route: 350-student subset of Tatsuoka's 600-student file (also on CRAN as candisc::HSB), via the UC Berkeley EDUC 275B course files.
redistribution_basis: NCES public-use survey data printed in a textbook appendix and redistributed on CRAN (candisc).

title: Earnings, education and job sector (CPS 2000)
description: Annual earnings, education, sex and job sector of 55,899 adults aged 25-65 from the March 2000 Current Population Survey.
source_citation: U.S. Census Bureau. (2000). Current Population Survey: Annual demographic file, 2000 [Data set]. ICPSR 3048. https://doi.org/10.3886/ICPSR03048.v1
source_route: Extract of unknown authorship, via the UC Berkeley EDUC 275B course files.
redistribution_basis: U.S. federal government data, not subject to copyright (17 U.S.C. 105).

title: Teachers' math knowledge and first-grade math gains
description: Math gains of 1,190 first graders in 312 classrooms and 107 schools, with teacher and school characteristics.
source_citation: West, B. T., Welch, K. B., & Galecki, A. T. (2006). Linear mixed models: A practical guide using statistical software. Chapman & Hall/CRC. Data from the Study of Instructional Improvement (Hill, Rowan, & Ball, 2005, American Educational Research Journal, 42(2), 371-406).
source_route: The classroom data of West, Welch and Galecki, as instruction.dta in Rabe-Hesketh and Skrondal (Stata Press), via the UC Berkeley EDUC 275B course files; also on CRAN (WWGbook).
redistribution_basis: Teaching extract publicly released by the book's authors and Stata Press, redistributed on CRAN (WWGbook).

title: NELS:88 base year and first follow-up (2,000 students)
description: 299 questionnaire items, composites and test scores for 2,000 NELS:88 students in 1988 (grade 8) and 1990 (grade 10).
source_citation: National Center for Education Statistics. National Education Longitudinal Study of 1988 (NELS:88): Public-use data files, base year (1988) and first follow-up (1990). U.S. Department of Education.
source_route: Teaching extract of 2,000 students prepared for UC Berkeley GSE courses (EDUC 293A/275B), about 2004.
redistribution_basis: NCES public-use data: all 296 named NELS variables (plus id, the NCES student ID STU_ID) are in the public-use files (checked against the NCES variable list).

title: Death-penalty verdicts in Florida
description: Defendant's race, victim's race and death-penalty verdict for 674 defendants in Florida multiple-murder indictments, 1976-1987.
source_citation: Radelet, M. L., & Pierce, G. L. (1991). Choosing those who will die: Race and the death penalty in Florida. Florida Law Review, 43(1), 1-34.
source_route: Via Agresti and Finlay (1997), Statistical Methods for the Social Sciences (3rd ed., p. 585), and the UC Berkeley EDUC 275B course files.
redistribution_basis: Published aggregate table, expanded to one row per defendant; also on CRAN (catdata, asbio).

title: PISA 2000 reading: UK, Germany and USA
description: Reading scores, parental occupation and background of 4,528 15-year-olds in three countries, PISA 2000.
source_citation: OECD. (2002). PISA 2000 technical report. OECD Publishing. Data: OECD PISA 2000 database.
source_route: Three-country teaching extract made for the UC Berkeley EDUC 275B course, with derived variables as in Rabe-Hesketh and Skrondal (Stata Press).
redistribution_basis: OECD terms allow copying and distribution with credit to the OECD; this package is not endorsed by the OECD.

title: Reading comprehension experiment
description: Pre- and post-test reading comprehension of 66 students randomly assigned to three methods of teaching reading.
source_citation: Moore, D. S., & McCabe, G. P. (1993). Introduction to the practice of statistics (2nd ed., pp. 794-795). W. H. Freeman. Data from an experiment by Baumann and Jones (Purdue University).
source_route: Via the UC Berkeley EDUC 275B course files; identical to carData::Baumann on CRAN.
redistribution_basis: Published textbook data, redistributed on CRAN (carData, GPL).

title: Job satisfaction by income and gender
description: Job satisfaction, income and gender of 110 workers: Agresti's 1991 GSS table with one case added to each of its six empty cells.
source_citation: Agresti, A. (2002). Categorical data analysis (2nd ed., Table 7.8). Wiley. Data: 1991 General Social Survey.
source_route: Individual-level expansion of the published table made for the UC Berkeley EDUC 275B course; the same table is on CRAN as coin::jobsatisfaction.
redistribution_basis: Published aggregate table of counts, redistributed on CRAN (coin).
notes: Not simulated: one case was added to each of the six empty cells of the published table (104 -> 110).

title: Titanic passenger survival
description: Survival, class, sex, age, fare and port of embarkation of 1,309 passengers of the Titanic.
source_citation: Cason, T. (1999). titanic3 [Data set]. Department of Biostatistics, Vanderbilt University. Based on Encyclopedia Titanica and Eaton and Haas (1994), Titanic: Triumph and Tragedy.
source_route: Six of the 14 titanic3 variables, via the UC Berkeley EDUC 275B course files; embarked re-taken from titanic3 in 1.0.0.
redistribution_basis: Historical passenger records, publicly distributed by Vanderbilt Biostatistics and redistributed on CRAN (carData, PASWR).

title: Canadian women's labour-force participation
description: Work status, husband's income, presence of children and region of 263 married Canadian women in 1977.
source_citation: Fox, J. (2016). Applied regression analysis and generalized linear models (3rd ed.). Sage. Data: Social Change in Canada Project, York Institute for Social Research (1977).
source_route: Stata Press companion data of Rabe-Hesketh and Skrondal, via the UC Berkeley EDUC 275B course files; identical to carData::Womenlf on CRAN.
redistribution_basis: Published textbook data, redistributed on CRAN (carData, GPL) and by Stata Press.
